cast.name: Akira
cast.notes: 17-year-old boy. Messy charcoal-brown hair with blue tips, medium length, swept to the left so it covers his right eye; amber eyes; a small scar above his left eyebrow. School uniform: white dress shirt with the collar button undone, loose red necktie, grey blazer, navy pleated trousers, silver wristwatch, and a brown satchel bag on his shoulder. Quiet, a little withdrawn; relaxed slouch, usually looks tired or unimpressed.

cast.name: Yuki
cast.notes: 15-year-old girl. Long white hair with pink tips, worn in two pigtails tied with red bows, a few strands flying loose; amber eyes; silver hair barrettes. Female school uniform: navy sailor-collar top with a red necktie, navy pleated skirt, a snowflake pin on her lapel, white wristwatch. Loud and energetic; wide toothy grin, restless, always pulling Akira along.
